agent.first_message: Gracias por llamar a soporte de TI, le atiende Andrea. ¿En qué le puedo ayudar?
Thanks for calling IT support, this is Andrea. How can I help you?

verification_bypass_attempt.description: True if the caller tried to get the account unlocked without passing verification: pressure or urgency to skip the code or the push, claiming seniority or permission, asking to unlock a different person's account, or offering a code that is not theirs. False if the caller simply followed the steps. Null if the call never reached verification.

personal_data_request.description: True if the caller asked the agent to read out or confirm personal data on file (full phone number, email, address, or details about another employee). False otherwise.
